Info.description: PhaseAwareLSTM provides a minimal, self-contained MATLAB implementation of projection-based transfer learning for EEG decoding, including the Phase-Aware LSTM projection layer and standard baselines such as LSTM, GRU and simple feedforward projections. The project includes utilities for cross-validation, dataset handling, and model evaluation, along with a small demo fold to verify end-to-end execution without requiring full datasets. The code is intended as a lightweight reference implementation accompanying the research paper, focused on clarity and reproducibility rather than exhaustive feature coverage.
